cohort: Women giving birth in New South Wales, Australia, between 1994 and 2013, with a first-time diagnosis of gestational breast cancer (study group) compared to women giving birth without any type of cancer (comparison group).
finding: Women with gestational breast cancer (GBC) have a high incidence of preterm birth and their babies are more likely to be low birthweight or admitted to higher care, with women aged >=35 years having an increased risk of GBC.
mod_finding: Women with gestational breast cancer were more likely to give birth by labour induction or pre-labour C-section compared to women without cancer.
